method.unit: One distinct game/row/column target with an observed keyboard-focus indicator contrast defect. This is one CSS root cause affecting 586 targets, not 586 independent implementation defects.
method.previousAuditRelationship: These are separate focus defects at existing board coordinates. Previously fixed target-size problems are not re-counted; this is not a claim of 586 new physical coordinates.
method.deduplication: Repeated sizes, viewports and sampled focus checks are counted once per game/coordinate/rule.
method.customCheck: Rendered author-provided outline versus the actual opaque wooden board fill, using WCAG relative luminance and a 3:1 non-text contrast threshold. This is not an axe-reported finding.
method.exclusions: Go 9/13 subsets, duplicate viewport checks, 50 passing forest/echo exploratory theme states, tests and CI changes are not additional findings.

repair.description: Scope an opaque dark focus ring to Go/Gomoku buttons, place it inside the target and keep it above neighboring content.

validation.checks: Actual focus-visible state, complete inset outline geometry, native Tab sequence, unchanged empty boards and viewport width. Existing source/catalog/55-page skip navigation and 11 Node test files passed.
validation.network: Local production assets only; external HTTP/WebSockets blocked and service workers disabled. No account or database writes.
validation.ci: Added to the existing Dense board touch and keyboard regression job. New PR CI pending at report creation.

limits: The detector intentionally handles only the current opaque, solid board fills and fails on unsupported patterned/translucent fills.
Initial empty boards and the described focus states were checked; this does not cover all games or all gameplay states.
Computed contrast and geometry plus visual review do not replace real-device or screen-reader usability testing.
